dataset_description: Dealer-level current-year and last-year revenue for the latest reporting month, for a fixed list of 10 dealers.

reporting_period_logic.latest_reporting_month: MAX(month) in the current year where sales_actual_MTD is not null
reporting_period_logic.current_year_window: year = current year AND month = latest_reporting_month
reporting_period_logic.last_year_window: year = current year - 1 AND month = latest_reporting_month

cy_revenue_eur.description: Current-year actual revenue for the latest reporting month.

ly_revenue_eur.description: Prior-year actual revenue for the same reporting month.

lat_month.description: The latest current-year month number used for both current-year and last-year figures.

llm_instructions: Base the insight on the latest reporting month only (lat_month).
Support every statement with actual metric values.
Do not invent business reasons, market causes, supply chain issues, customer behaviour, or operational explanations.
lat_month is a number (1-12); convert it to a month name in the narrative.
If cy_revenue_eur > ly_revenue_eur, describe the dealer as growing year-over-year.
If cy_revenue_eur < ly_revenue_eur, describe the dealer as declining year-over-year.
Quantify the absolute difference and percentage change between cy and ly revenue where possible.
